name: prf-003
description: Sizes for FullLoadTest (PRF-003). full is the ADR 0010 floor: 50,000 value changes/s for 1 h on S8 from the networked simulator through drivers, with historian, alarms and journal, and 75 subscribed sessions. ci is the Load bench job size: fewer points for a short window, same client count. Every point changes once per 1000 ms simulator period; tags scan faster so no change is aliased away. commsTimeoutMillis is set on every tag: with the default 0 a sample a few ms late reads as comms loss (see docs/agent/reports/prf-003.md).
